visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails wearing a mint green floral dress sits cross-legged on a light wood floor. She holds a purple felt grape toy to her mouth, mimicking eating while an air purifier stands in the background next to white storage bins. (2) The girl picks up a red felt strawberry toy, smiling broadly at the camera with squinted eyes. The lighting is bright and natural from a nearby window. She brings the toy to her face to pretend eat again. (3) The scene shifts as an older child in a white shirt joins the toddler. They sit on the floor playing with a colorful felt activity book. A ginger cat walks calmly in the background towards a set of stairs. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the toddler's small hands as she carefully matches felt shapes like a star and a circle into their corresponding white silhouettes on a dark brown felt page. (5) The toddler stands and walks across a play area towards a wooden cat tree. She holds a felt fried egg toy. Another ginger cat is perched inside a hole in the cat tree. (6) She reaches out to the cat tree, offering the felt egg to the cat inside. The cat sniffs the toy while the toddler watches closely. The room is spacious with a view of a kitchen in the background. (7) An animated screen appears with a pink background featuring a cartoon girl waving her hand, accompanied by brand text.
